title: Titan Core: Reforged
tagline: Rip apart war machines, socket their cores, then gamble the escape.
pitch: Titan Core: Reforged is a compact neon arena run where a mobile assault core blasts drones, breaks a towering machine Titan, and vacuums up the components it leaves behind. Salvage is spent instantly between clashes to overcharge the player's cannon, armor, or pulse radius, culminating in a sharp choice: bank the run or descend into a more dangerous final wave.
coreLoop: Move around a single-screen arena, aim and fire a rapid core cannon, then collect dropped salvage before the next threat closes in. Spend collected salvage at a brief Forge Ring to gain a real stat increase, defeat the Titan, and choose extraction or a high-risk bonus descent.

mechanics.name: Core Cannon
mechanics.description: WASD movement combines with mouse aim and held primary fire or Space fire. Shots create a bright impact spark, enemy recoil flash, short hit-stop, and a readable damage pip on contact.

mechanics.name: Titan Encounter
mechanics.description: A large segmented hex-frame Titan enters after the opening drone squad. Its oversized health bar, named warning banner, stomp shockwaves, and rotating bolt spread clearly distinguish it from small drones.

mechanics.name: Salvage Magnet
mechanics.description: Destroyed drones and Titan armor nodes eject glowing component shards. Entering pickup range pulls shards into the player and increases the Salvage counter.

mechanics.name: Forge Ring Upgrades
mechanics.description: At an illuminated center ring, collected salvage can immediately buy one of three compact upgrades: Cannon Output increases shot damage, Core Plating increases maximum and current core health, and Pulse Coil increases the knockback pulse radius. Each purchase changes a live gameplay stat and visibly changes the player's core geometry.

mechanics.name: Extraction Gamble
mechanics.description: After the Titan falls, a full-screen-clear but non-blocking decision gate presents two large choices: EXTRACT banks the run for victory, while DESCEND starts a short bonus wave with doubled score value and more projectile pressure.

controls.keyboard: WASD or Arrow Keys move; Space fires toward the pointer; E confirms EXTRACT; R confirms DESCEND.
controls.mouse: Move to aim; hold left button to fire; click the large extraction-choice panels.
controls.touch: Optional: left-side drag moves, right-side drag aims and fires; tap a choice panel to confirm.

artDirection.backgroundFx: A deep navy arena grid slowly parallax-scrolls beneath faint furnace haze, drifting sparks, and occasional cyan circuit pulses.

audioDirection.musicMood: tense synthetic foundry pulse that intensifies during the Titan phase

difficulty.start: The first slow drones approach from broad lanes with low health, giving immediate safe targets and plentiful salvage.
difficulty.progression: Drone count and projectile cadence rise gently; the Titan alternates readable stomp and bolt patterns while salvage upgrades keep player power ahead of pressure.
difficulty.peak: DESCEND lasts roughly 25 seconds, adds fast bolt drones around the arena edge, and rewards doubled score before a clean victory or core collapse.

winLose.win: Defeat the Titan and choose EXTRACT, or survive the bonus DESCEND wave; the final screen reports banked Score, Salvage spent, and Core level.
winLose.lose: Core health reaches zero during combat.

juice.screenShake: Light shake on cannon impacts, medium shake on Titan stomps, and a heavy two-beat shake when the Titan is destroyed.
juice.particles: Plasma fragments burst on every hit; drones spill magnetic shards; the Titan sheds large orange armor flakes and cyan energy arcs.
juice.hitStop: A 45 ms stop occurs on lethal drone hits and an 80 ms stop occurs when a Titan armor segment breaks.
juice.flash: The target flashes white-cyan on damage, the player core blooms on upgrade purchase, and the entire arena briefly inverts cyan-orange on Titan defeat.

scopeNotes: Do not build scrolling levels, procedural maps, inventory grids, dialogue trees, multiple weapon families, online features, external art/audio, or a pre-game tutorial sequence. This is a newly authored single-screen implementation with a Forge Ring and post-Titan extraction gate, not a recreation or visual reskin of Titan Core: Salvage.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: During playing, a player-fired Core Cannon shot can land on a hostile and emits attack_landed only when the real hit reaction, damage application, and impact feedback occur.
During playing, titan_and_threats_active is emitted only while the named large Titan is active in the arena and at least one smaller drone or hostile projectile is simultaneously active.
Spending collected salvage at the Forge Ring emits salvage_upgrade_applied with a live numeric player combat or survivability stat greater after the purchase than before it.
During active play after score progress, hud_layout_clear is emitted only when distinct Core, Score/Salvage, and Progress HUD regions are rendered within non-overlapping layout bounds.
After the Titan is defeated, confirming either EXTRACT or DESCEND emits extraction_choice_made only when the selected risk/reward outcome becomes active.
The complete observed run emits no legacy_salvage_mode event, demonstrating that no compatibility mode or reused Titan Core: Salvage flow is active.
The complete observed run emits no hud_overlap_detected event; the HUD layout checker must emit that event if any mandatory HUD bounds overlap or leave the canvas.
Every observed upgrade application changes a real numeric gameplay stat, as evidenced by salvage_upgrade_applied carrying a greater after value than before value.
A run started from title reaches active playing by the verifier early evidence point with movement, firing, and hostile targets already available, without a tutorial state.

scoreEvents: score increases when a drone is destroyed
score increases by a larger fixed value when a Titan armor segment is destroyed and when the Titan is defeated
score increases at doubled values for enemies destroyed during bonus_wave
Salvage collection increases the Salvage value but does not itself increase Score
